newsitem.title: USA: Duff raises Fisher Scientific note rating.
newsitem.headline: Duff raises Fisher Scientific note rating.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Monday it upgraded the senior unsecured notes of Fisher Scientific International Inc to triple-B from triple-B-minus.
The action follows the recent conversion of the company's $125 million convertible subordinated notes to equity, which will improve cash flow and provide additional financial flexibility, it added.
Duff said the upgrade also assumes continued progress in the reduction of costs and improvement in operating margins as the company merges the operations of recent acquisitions.
Fisher Scientific is a large distributor of scientific equipment and supplies, primarily to industrial and academic laboratories.
